checks.assessment: Source checks enforce planned base and tighter oracle coverage, recompute fixed and 101-point grid allocations, validate discrete grid indices and reject material negative losses. checks.limitations: The first-eight sensitivity rule does not cover every deterministic edge case. Finite checks do not prove universal curvature, strict inequalities or arbitrary-input solver correctness.

checks.assessment: The supplement binds the reviewed source inventory, planned job identities, manifest outputs and summary inputs; it rechecks bindings and manifest-path inventories after execution. checks.assessment: The native entrypoint accepts the declared verifier alias and rejects conflicting declarations. VerificationItem outputs match the enclosed schema.
